guide.overview: [CONTENT NEEDED] Describe what the SCA is and what makes it useful.
guide.what_you_produce: [CONTENT NEEDED] List the three results: Strategic Clarity Profile, Pattern Analysis, Immediate Blueprint.
guide.save_resume_behavior: Your work saves automatically as you answer. You can close anytime and return where you left off.
guide.privacy_statement: All your responses stay in your browser's local storage. The SCA does not send your answers to a server or analyze them externally.
guide.reset_behavior: You can reset and start fresh with a new assessment at any time. Resetting clears all responses for that session.
guide.product_boundaries: This is an educational self-assessment. It is not a diagnostic tool, personality test, clinical evaluation, or professional advice.
guide.accessibility_statement: The SCA supports High Contrast, Readable Font, Text Scale, and Reduced Motion controls.

launcher.role_description: Assess your current thinking across three dimensions of clarity.
